name: POST /api/leadflow/digests/escalate - overdue outputs, once each
description:
Escalates every required output still open past its due time (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC3). STAMPED ONCE, by an UPDATE ... WHERE escalated_at IS NULL rather than by reading and then writing: the sweep runs on a timer and two concurrent passes would both read "not yet escalated", and a manager who gets the same escalation on every tick stops reading them - which is precisely the failure the escalation exists to prevent.

MEASURED LIVE: eight outputs escalated on the first call and zero on the second, which is the guarantee rather than an empty queue.

The notification is best-effort and the stamp is durable, in that order. An escalation that was recorded but not delivered is recoverable; one that was delivered but not recorded fires again on the next tick.

testCases.name: Overdue outputs escalate, and escalate only once
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
